reviews.body: 🦸‍♂️ Approved on head 60cd9b4c. Reviewed the diff: bounded pagination (20 pages x 1000), repeated-token stop, first-page error surfaces while later-page failure keeps collected models (matches the Anthropic listing from #1648), API key is kept out of logs, and the table test covers pages / first-error / later-error / repeat / empty using a stubbed transport. dev-targeted, CLEAN, go/web/release-versioning all SUCCESS. Minor note, not blocking: the Gemini listing could later filter to models supporting generateContent, out of scope here.
